$comment: The org substrate's schema as data, read by core/lib/org/schema.js. Each kind names the folder new items are written to, its statuses, the terminal ones (reaching one sets resolved_fields and moves the file into <folder>/resolved/), the status an item without a status field has, and the frontmatter fields every item of the kind carries. A terminal status in unlanded_statuses means the work did not land anywhere, so its resolution is a plain one-line reason; every other terminal status needs a resolution naming where the work landed ([[wikilink]] or URL). The field `kind` names an item's kind and its value is the kind's name. house.toml [org] may add kinds, statuses and folders, never remove these, and may say how a house that predates lampstand names and places its items; house_toml is the JSON Schema subset that table is validated against.

house_toml.description: house.toml [org]. kind_field is the frontmatter field that names an item's kind (default kind); title_fallback = "heading" lets the first level-1 heading of the body stand in for an absent title field; not_items lists globs of house-relative paths (* within one folder name, ? one character, a ** segment any number of folders, matched case-sensitively) naming Markdown files in org folders that are not items: they are never read or linted as items, and their links are still checked; missing_frontmatter = "error" makes a file with no frontmatter in an org folder a lint error (default "info": information that it is not read as an item). [org.kinds.<name>] for a kind not above defines it (folder, statuses and terminal required; initial defaults to the first status, required to kind, title, status, created). For a kind above, folder, initial and required may not be given; statuses, terminal (new statuses only) and folders are added to the defaults. For any kind: kind_value is the value of kind_field that names it (default its name); nested = true also reads items from subfolders of its folders; status_folders maps a status to the one folder items with that status live in (a status not named there lives in the kind's folder, or its resolved/ folder when terminal), and a folder named by exactly one status implies that status for an item there without a status field; lists names fields that, when given (not absent, null or empty), must hold a list; fields maps a field lampstand reads and writes (title, status, created, due, resolved, resolution) to the name this house's items use for it, everywhere lampstand reads or writes it; resolution_required = false lets a terminal item of the kind go without a resolution line (default true: a terminal item carries both resolved and resolution). Cross-field rules are checked by core/lib/org/schema.js.
